title: Particle Orbit
description: An oblique cloud of luminous points forms a deep orbit; bass expands its volume while musical detail lights the nearer particles.

parameters.label: Orbit Size
parameters.description: Radius of the orbiting point cloud.

parameters.label: Orbit Tilt
parameters.description: Projected tilt of the cloud in space.

parameters.label: Particle Density
parameters.description: Number of particle cells around the orbit.

parameters.label: Spark
parameters.description: Local musical brightening of the nearer points.
